title: 6-layer periodic quarter-wave stack with expanded thickness bounds
scientific_hypothesis: Reducing layer count from 8 to 6 while expanding thickness bounds will yield valid candidates where route_01 failed, because fewer interfaces reduce material data lookup failures and wider bounds increase feasible region coverage.
design_principle: Quarter-wave stack with (0.5L H 0.5L) periodic structure centered at 9500 nm for LWIR transmission, using ZnS as low-index and ZnSe as high-index layers on Ge substrate.
proposed_topology: Air | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | Ge substrate (6 finite layers total, 3 pairs)
design_variables: Thickness initialization bounds 500-2500 nm per layer
manufacturing_considerations: Quarter-wave optical thickness at 9500 nm center wavelength
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for dichroic filter design
Reduced layer count decreases material data lookup complexity
expected_advantages: Lower material_data failure probability with fewer layers
Expanded bounds increase valid candidate yield
known_risks: Reduced layer count may limit stopband depth in MWIR
May not achieve same performance as 8-layer design if material data becomes available
execution_request_english: Design a 6-layer periodic quarter-wave dielectric stack on Ge substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe (6 finite layers). Initialize thicknesses at quarter-wave optical thickness centered at 9500 nm wavelength with bounds 500-2500 nm per layer. Optimize for high transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band and low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. Total layer count fixed at 6. Use normal incidence, unpolarized light. Verify all material optical constants are available across both wavelength bands before optimization. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 8000-11000 nm, 3000-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band; Low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count not exceeding 16.
revision_reason: Route_01 failed with 0 valid candidates due to material_data issues. This route reduces layer count from 8 to 6 and expands thickness bounds to 500-2500 nm to increase feasible region and reduce material data lookup failures.
